body.statement: On \(G_n\), the true intensity profile \(\bar q\) belongs to the completed-log enclosure \(\mathcal Q_n(e)\). Moreover, every \(q'\in\mathcal Q_n(e)\) satisfies \(\|q'-\bar q\|_{\infty}\le d_{Q,n}=2\delta_{q,n}+2L_q(\varepsilon_n+1/n)\).
body.justification: This converts the completed propensity log into a simultaneous deterministic enclosure without conditioning away assignment dependence.
body.gap: FreidlingZhaoGao2026 uses exact selection-event conditioning; no located result supplies a shrinking Lipschitz intensity enclosure for an approximate critical law.
body.consumer: The deterministic inclusion is the selection-safety input for the certified radius used in the GUSTO-1 and EUROPA bridge analysis.
